body:
I bought 5 gram package of Sinicuichi from a local store. Went home, cut it up, rolled it up, smoked it. This herb burns slow, has a sweet smell to it. It's powerful, I only smoked one gram and I felt it. It's a wicked herb, I think it's better than marijuana, cause it doesn't make me all stoned.
I started hearing voices, but not exactly, it was as if I was receiving knowledge, information from a outside source. Ideas started to pop in my head, I felt like I was in a deep state of contemplation. At one point I was getting emotional, I was playing a movie through my head, it was motivation, inspiration, the things I need to do.
It's a good herb.
